name: Bald Eagle
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of the eagle's wings to illustrate God's powerful and sustaining care for His people. In Exodus 19:4, God describes how He bore His people on eagles' wings, symbolizing His deliverance and protection. Isaiah 40:31 further reveals that those who wait upon the Lord will be strengthened and lifted up like eagles, able to endure without weariness. Revelation 12:14 depicts the woman given two wings of a great eagle to escape danger and be nourished, emphasizing God's provision and refuge in times of trial.
